proposal.reason: Main change is communicator-level configuration controls (validation/default/env override, rank agreement, and comm state for nChannelsPerNetPeer/graphUsageMode/maxP2pPeers). Enqueue is additionally required because strong-stream graph-mixing semantics and P2P task channel budgeting logic changed in runtime planning. Device-topology is additionally required because P2P per-peer channel derivation and max-peer-aware channel computation were changed in src/graph/paths.cc.
